name: GoGo SqueeZ 100% Fruit Applesauce On-The-Go Pouch
whyItWorks: 100% pure pureed apples with zero skins, seeds, or added sugar. The sealed pouch makes it completely shelf-stable and pocket-friendly for work, school, or travel emergencies.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Twist off the helicopter cap and squeeze directly into mouth. Excellent quick energy boost when you cannot tolerate solid food.
watchOuts: Avoid fruit pouch varieties with blended strawberry/raspberry seeds or added citric acid.
